dct_description_sm:
Potential rapid transit corridors, as depicted in Brampton Plan Schedule 1A-City Structure. Classified into Corridors, Planned Corridors and Support Corridors.
Support Corridors are transportation corridors that complement and reinforce the primary transit network by improving connectivity between major destinations, centres, corridors, and transit hubs. They help create an integrated mobility system that supports planned growth and efficient movement throughout the city.  Planned corridors being those that have yet to be completed, and serve a similar purpose for future transportation plans.

This data is intended to be used in conjuction with other related mapping layers for this schedule, and may be impacted by other schedules, with consideration to the text of Brampton Plan.
